name: Nanjing Comptech Composites Corp
summary: Nanjing CompTECH Composites Corporation is a Chinese enterprise that specializes in the research, development, and manufacturing of sealing solutions and glass fiber reinforced plastic (GFRP) products. The company's diverse product range also encompasses advanced polymers, various new materials, rubber-based items, optoelectronic components, metallic connectors, and molds. Established in 2001, the company is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
